name: Demo: Free Movement & Capture
description: A rule-free sandbox on a Go-style 9×9 board: move your stones one step at a time and capture by landing on an opponent's stone. There is no win condition.
rules: Players alternate moving one of their stones one step up, down, left or right.
Moving onto an opponent's stone captures it. You may not move onto your own stones.
There is no win condition; this game exists to exercise the platform.
